thread:
jordan: Quick heads up — proposing a staggered unpin of runtime 3.1.x -> 3.2.1 tonight in 3 waves starting 22:00 UTC. Canaries first, then regional pools.
anya: +1 but we need explicit backout criteria. Suggest: error rate spike > 1% OR median p95 latency increase > 30ms for 2 consecutive minutes.
sam: Model compatibility question: raven-1b-quant has a kv-cache layout change in 3.2.x, could affect hosted longseq calls.
alex: Raven team perf: short seq fine, longseq (>1024) shows small token alignment diffs, not OOM but possible response drift. See internal link for diffs.
maria: Given drift risk, can we exclude raven-1b-quant from wave1 and pin for wave2 until telemetry looks good?
jordan: Plan: wave1 = canaries (no raven traffic), wave2 = regional pools with raven pinned, wave3 = global with raven migrated. Auto backout signal enabled.
deploybot: Scheduled: STAGED_UNPIN runtime=3.2.1 start=2026-11-12T22:00:00Z waves=3 spacing=15m deploybot_id=deploy_1760432100
anya: Backout ops: deploybot should emit BACKOUT_REQUIRED webhook if error_rate > 1% OR p95_increase > 30ms for 2min. On-call runbook: pause wave + rollback last wave if webhook received.
srebot: I'll add the alert rule and a short-circuit to the autoscaler to avoid capacity flapping during rollback.
sam: If rollback needed, what's the command?
anya: ``/deploybot abort deploy_1760432100 --rollback --reason "compat spike"``. That reverts runtime on affected pools to previous pinned version.
alex: Add telemetry tag "unpin_1760432100" for trace filtering.
maria: Can we shift start by 30m for APAC? Infrastructure on-call availability.
jordan: OK shift to 22:30 UTC. deploybot, update schedule.
deploybot: Updated: STAGED_UNPIN runtime=3.2.1 start=2026-11-12T22:30:00Z waves=3 spacing=15m deploybot_id=deploy_1760432100
[22:40 UTC] deploybot: wave1 started -> canary-northamerica, canary-eu. rolling...
[22:42 UTC] alex: small p95 blip in canary-eu: +18ms, error_rate steady.
[22:44 UTC] anya: within thresholds, continue monitoring.
[22:46 UTC] deploybot: wave1 complete. wave2 starting in 4m (regional pools).
[22:52 UTC] deploybot: wave2 started -> region-eu-1, region-na-2. raven-1b-quant traffic excluded per plan.
[22:54 UTC] srebot: Alert: p95 increase detected in region-eu-1: +35ms sustained 2 minutes.
[22:54 UTC] deploybot: BACKOUT_REQUIRED webhook emitted for deploy_1760432100 -> reason: p95_increase
anya: Abort and rollback wave2 now. Use rollback command.
jordan: Executing rollback.
anya: ``/deploybot abort deploy_1760432100 --rollback --reason "p95_increase_region_eu_1"``
deploybot: Action accepted. Rolling back runtime on affected targets: region-eu-1.
[22:58 UTC] deploybot: rollback complete for region-eu-1. wave2 paused.
sam: Raven team — does this require client changes?
alex: We kept raven pinned in region-eu-1 so no client action; only partially-applied 3.2.1 nodes rolled back.
maria: Propose expanded canary with synthetic longseq prompts for raven before reattempt.
anya: Agreed. Run targeted canary for raven in controlled lane and collect token-diff stats for 1 hour. Criteria to proceed: token-diff rate < 0.5% and p95 < +20ms.
jordan: I'll open a PR for release notes: include compatibility note and rollback summary; flag EU customers using raven longseq.
srebot: Added incident tag "unpin_1760432100-backout" and set telemetry retention 90 days.
[23:40 UTC] deploybot: hold lifted for deploy_1760432100 pending manual resume. Waiting on canary audit.
anya: Canary audit complete: token-diff 0.12%, p95 +12ms. Safe to resume but keep raven excluded for wave3 until tomorrow.
jordan: Resume scheduled 07:00 UTC tomorrow for wave3; raven migration at 12:00 UTC next day.
sam: Sounds good, thanks everyone. :thumbsup: \nalex: Filing follow-up: add preflight longseq smoke for all model migrations.
maria: I'll notify CS for EU customers that saw ephemeral latency.
